subject: RSW_Plant_Nysyllin_Wild
departures: low, soft-stemmed herbaceous plant, not a woody shrub or tree
wild growth habit: an irregular, uneven clump rather than a tidy cultivated row plant
dense harvestable leafy foliage that reads as a medicinal herb crop, with no flowers, fruit or seed heads as the focal point
must not be a recognisable Earth culinary herb (mint, basil, sage leaf shape); the leaf form should be its own
